name: Rochelle Davis
bio: Rochelle Davis (birth name: Andrea Hunsberger; born June 14, 1980) is an American actress best known for her role as Sarah in the 1994 film adaptation of James O’Barr’s comic book The Crow.

credits.title: Lookout Weekend: Cruel Summer IV
credits.overview: When a severed human hand is found at a weekend film festival, the actual cast and crew of the CRUEL SUMMER trilogy suddenly find themselves thrown into the middle of a real-life sequel engineered by an unhinged psychopath.

credits.title: Revenge of the Devil Bat
credits.overview: Revenge of the Devil Bat" is a modern day sequel to the popular 1940's Bela Lugosi movie "The Devil Bat".

credits.title: Hell House
credits.overview: Within the city limits of Devilin lies a home the towns folk call "Hell House". A house that was once the home of a family accused of mass murder. A family known as the Reapers.

credits.title: The Crow
credits.overview: Exactly one year after young rock guitarist Eric Draven and his fiancée are brutally killed by a ruthless gang of criminals, Draven, watched over by a hypnotic crow, returns from the grave to exact revenge.
